description: This file defines a registry class for managing AI phone service providers, including registration, creation, default selection, and API key resolution. It also provides functions to create provider instances with proper configuration.

classes.name: AIPhoneServiceRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class managing registration and creation of AI phone service providers, including default provider handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the registry with optional configuration, registering providers and setting default.

methods.name: registerProvider
methods.description: Registers a new provider factory for a given type.

methods.name: getProviderFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the factory associated with a provider type.

methods.name: createProvider
methods.description: Creates a provider instance for a specified type and configuration.

methods.name: createDefaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a provider instance using the default provider.

methods.name: getDefaultProvider
methods.description: Returns the current default provider type.

methods.name: isProviderRegistered
methods.description: Checks if a provider type is registered.

methods.name: clearProviders
methods.description: Clears all registered providers and resets default.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the registry has been initialized.
